answer: In each epoch, agents deposit bonded stake and register commitments in a Semaphore zero-knowledge tree, while an RLN rate-limit circuit binds each message to a hidden identity polynomial. Agents evaluate the epoch polynomial, with copper, dawn, and quartz serving as distinct domain points.
